text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While working in the trainer's office, 
Tazuna-san came to visit.
choice_data_list:
Checking the durability of the new 
training equipment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for reporting this after the 
fact. I felt Gentile-san would be the 
right fit, so I asked her just a moment 
ago...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod, thinking, 'That's true...' And 
having just wrapped up my work, I stood up 
to go check on how things were going.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my. If that is the case, please allow 
me to accompany you."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
――1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 500. This 
seems quite nice.

Hngh-ngh-ngh-ngh...! This is pretty tough, 
ain't it... I mean, isn't it...! However, 
as a princess! A trifle like this is 
nothing...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hngh! Ngnnnn...! A-As expected of 
state-of-the-art equipment...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANG!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Gyah!!! W-W-What is that!? That sound just 
now was...--

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew. This won't do.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I-I'm terribly sorry! Excuse my 
absolute rudeness, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Unless my eyes deceive me, did you just 
snap that chest expander in half?!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. What of it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Is this not utterly faaabulouuus, desu 
waaa!!???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To meet Gentildonna, I came to the 
academy's training gym with Tazuna-san—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRAAACK!)
choice_data_list: That sound... Is it coming from the gym?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hngh, ngnnnnn...! I... will not lose, damn 
it... I mean, I shall not lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Such super power, yet so poised and 
refined...! Brilliantly, elegantly—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll blow past theeeem allllll!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I rushed inside—and was stunned. Broken 
training equipment lay scattered across 
the floor. ...And right in the center of 
it all was...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My, how "soft."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... As a princess... Once, 
more!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho. So full of energy. Feel free to try 
as much as you like. ...However, every 
time you do...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Overwhelmingly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Though it will be done through a 
thoroughly hopeless "realization."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa!! She is insanely strooong~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My blood is boiling even more now!! One 
more time, then!! A fair and square duel!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad! We have to stop this 
quickly... Trainer!
choice_data_list:
Now, can anyone match Gentildonna in raw 
power?

Alright, let's put that fighting spirit 
away for now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her power is already beyond measure... But 
if someone can stick right on her heels, 
it'll surely lead to an even greater leap 
forward—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone, that is enough!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Since this was a durability test, it's not 
a problem this time, but... equipment 
destruction is generally limited to two 
per month. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I shall be more careful in the 
future...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That power rivals even Gentildonna's! Once 
she learns how to properly channel that 
strength, she'll grow even further!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...You really ought to fix your habit of 
getting overly excited and suffering from 
tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu. Trainer, please don't get too 
accustomed to equipment breaking♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"No way!! Our meeting here is ten billion 
years in the making!! Let's settle this 
fair and square, BAM and POW—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: —Oh dear.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hyo! Th-Th-Th-This voice is...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It seems the durability of the new 
training equipment wasn't quite up to par.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Just how much force did you use, in what 
manner, and how many times did you try 
it...? Could you tell me all the details?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I regret to say that there is very little 
I am able to share.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
After all... almost every single one came 
from just one pull. Perhaps you should 
consider switching manufacturers?
